description: Retrieve the calculation-sheets workbook for a prior ifr_calculate or ifr_period_end_batch call. Returns a downloadUrl for the XLSX workbook (GET /api/ifrcoworker/calculation-sheets/{correlationId} with Bearer token) and a structured JSON summary of each sheet's data (journalEntries count, trialBalance accounts, financialStatements sections, disclosureNotes). The workbook also includes an editable valuation pack (analytical, not IFRS-required): a DCF model sheet with pre-filled assumptions (3% growth, 12% discount rate — amber editable cells), a standard-tagged net-debt bridge (IFRS 16 leases, IAS 19 pension, IAS 37 provisions, IFRS 3 consideration) and a multiples/EV-bridge sheet. Records are persisted in MongoDB for 24 hours — no re-calculation needed. This tool is free; downloading the workbook from downloadUrl costs 15 credits. Token required.

correlationId.description: correlationId from a prior ifr_calculate or ifr_period_end_batch response. Records are stored for 24 hours.

name: ifr_calculation_sheets
